doc.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005

title: Listening to 'Nola' and its articulation
summary: Playing back a recording of 'Nola' and his astonishing articulation.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: Yes. In fact I wanted to play just a brief thing here for you, okay? Let me see if I can get this piece up and perhaps you can tell me a little bit about it. We’ll just listen to.

And I think what you had played was “Nola.”
That’s right. Now listen to the bass player, he’s out of time.
This was released you know. They took it off the air.
Well, as a saxophone player, I want to tell you, that that’s impossible.
How did you do that? How did you learn to do that articulation?
